task.ques: Locate a baked salmon recipe on Allrecipes that has at least 50 reviews and a rating of 4.5 stars or higher. Note the primary seasoning or herb used and the estimated cooking time.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Lemon-Rosemary Salmon on Allrecipes qualifies with 4.7/5 stars (426 ratings) and 285 reviews. Its primary herb is fresh rosemary (4 sprigs), paired with lemon. Estimated cooking time: 15 minutes; total time: 25 minutes including 10 minutes of prep.
Source: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/80388/lemon-rosemary-salmon/ (verified October 27, 2026).
Evidence: final.png shows the recipe name, rating, and review count together. The page’s ingredients and time panel provide the herb and cooking time.
